Confluence 'Errata 4' (18 Sep 2026) · NOT yet on api-specs main

The 'KYCCaptured' status is removed from the set of QuoteStatus values an LFI may set on this endpoint — going forward only the TPP may set it (to signal completed KYC capture for LFI validation). Sighted only in the Confluence Consolidated Errata page's new 'Errata 4' section (2026-09-18); the api-specs main breaking-changes registers and the OpenAPI files themselves are unchanged (0/99, all 10 tracked registers byte-identical) — not yet enforced anywhere.
No action required today (not yet published to api-specs/API Hub). Insurance LFIs should stop self-setting KYCCaptured once this is formally published.

Content-Type correction: the advertised Content-Type for webhook event delivery changes from application/jwe (not a registered media type) to application/jwt (RFC 7519). Payload format is unchanged (still a nested JWT delivered as a JWE in Compact Serialization) -- only the declared header is corrected to match wire behaviour. Separately, the Insurance Quote Event schema makes QuoteId required in Data across all quote-event status branches (aligning Data with Meta, where it was already required), and AEInsuranceResourceIdentifierType drops its uuid format constraint (relaxation, not a restriction).

No action required today (V2.2 is still draft/RC). Once V2.2 is finalised: TPPs that dispatch on the Content-Type header must accept application/jwt; LFIs emitting Insurance Quote Events must include QuoteId in the event Data body, not just Meta.
API Hub Consent Manager (uae-api-hub-consent-manager) — GET /psu/{userId}/consents, POST /consents

GET /psu/{userId}/consents' status query parameter changes from a bare string to an array of AEConsentStatus (comma-separated); an unrecognized status value, previously silently accepted (empty result), is now rejected with HTTP 400. POST /consents' Creditor/Debtor Reference schemas gain a third variant: the existing unrestricted free-text branch is marked DEPRECATED (open strings will be withdrawn in a future version) alongside the OFP-003-patterned branch already enforced in v2.1-errata3; v2.2 today still validates a strict superset of v2.1 (nothing newly rejected).

No action required today (V2.2 is still draft/RC; nothing currently valid becomes invalid). LFIs/TPPs already on the OFP-003 charset are unaffected going forward. Any integration still sending unrestricted-charset Creditor/Debtor references should plan migration ahead of the open-string branch's future removal.

fillBasisNote: Counts use Active API-family registrations in the production directory. Family presence does not prove every release-specific function works or establish regulatory compliance.

prodGrid.note: Green = capability exposed in the production Trust Framework directory AND carrying live 2xx traffic in the public logs. Blue = exposed in production but no live 2xx traffic in the window. Hatched = not exposed for that capability in the production directory. Exposure is unambiguously production (production directory); Nebras publishes no per-environment volumes, so 'live' means observed successful traffic on the capability. Payments traffic is measured on initiation, so a 5xx-only initiation flow shows blue, not green.

adoptionNote: Production registration and successful public-log traffic are separate signals. The logs omit environment labels; absence of traffic does not establish non-compliance.
